               *   @brief      This service is used to process the Calibration command download 0xF0 request.
               *   @param[in]  XcpChannel  Channel Id type
               *   @param[in]  CmdPtr  pointer to the command buffer
               ********************************************************************************************************************/
               void Xcp_CalibCmdProcessorDownload
               (
                   Xcp_ChannelType XcpChannel,
                   uint8 * CmdPtr
               )
               {
                   uint8 Size;
1 0     (T)    Xcp_CalibCmdProcessorDownload
1 1      *       uint8 ErrorCode = 0x00u;
1 2      *       Size = CmdPtr[1];
1 3     (T)(F)   if (Size == 0U)
                   {
1 4      *         ErrorCode = 0x22u;
                   }
                   else 
1 5     (T)(F)     if (Xcp_ResourceProtectionCheck(XcpChannel,0x01u) != 0x00u)
                   {
1 6      *           ErrorCode = 0x25u;
                   }
                   else
                   {
1 7     (T)(F)       if (Size > Xcp_ChannelConfig[XcpChannel].DownloadSizeMax)
                       {
                           /* handle block mode */
1 8      *             Xcp_ChannelCtrlStatus[XcpChannel].NextDataBlockSize = Size - Xcp_ChannelConfig[XcpChannel].DownloadSizeMax;
1 9      *             Size = Xcp_ChannelConfig[XcpChannel].DownloadSizeMax;
1 10     *             ErrorCode = Xcp_WriteMta(XcpChannel,Size,&CmdPtr[2]);
                           /* Donot send response for block mode request */
1 11     *             Xcp_ChannelCtrlStatus[XcpChannel].ResponseBufferLen = 0U;
                       }
                       else
                       {
1 12     *             ErrorCode = Xcp_WriteMta(XcpChannel,Size,&CmdPtr[2]);
                       }
                   }
                   /* check and udpate error reponse */
1 13    (T)(F)   if (ErrorCode != 0x00u)
                   {
1 14    (T)(F)     if( ErrorCode == 0x01u )
                       {
1 15     *           Xcp_ChannelCtrlStatus[XcpChannel].ResponsePending = ((unsigned char)1U);
                       }
                       else
                       {
1 16     *           Xcp_SetNegativeResponse(XcpChannel,ErrorCode);
                       }
                   }
               }

2 14     *             Size = ((uint8)(Xcp_ChannelCtrlStatus[(XcpChannel)].MaxCto - 2u));

2 17    (T)(F)   if (ErrorCode != 0x00u)

2 18    (T)(F)     if( ErrorCode == 0x01u )

2 19     *           Xcp_ChannelCtrlStatus[XcpChannel].ResponsePending = ((unsigned char)1U);
